name: KanbanBoard
description: Work grouped into columns by stage. Each column has a title and count; each task is a card with its detail, tags and any actions, such as moving it to another column.
whenToUse: To see work across stages, e.g. To do, In progress, Done.
When people move items between stages.

whenNotToUse.text: For a flat list of tasks.
For many records with columns of data.

anatomy.name: Column
anatomy.description: One stage, with its title and count.

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.description: One task: title, detail, metadata and actions.

anatomy.name: Metadata
anatomy.description: Tags, dates and counts under the detail.

anatomy.name: Actions
anatomy.description: Controls on the card, e.g. a move menu.

values.meaning: Tighter cards and gaps, to fit more tasks on screen.

states.name: Default
states.meaning: Columns and their cards at rest.

states.name: Empty column
states.meaning: A stage with no tasks shows a count of zero.

behavior.text: On narrow screens the columns scroll sideways; each column keeps its width.
The board shows stages; moving a card is done through its actions, which update your data.
Columns run from the right in Arabic.

content: Name stages with verbs or states: "To do", "In progress", "Done".
Keep card titles short; put details in the description.

guidelines.do: Show the count in each column header.
guidelines.dont: Make people count cards to see how much work is in a stage.
guidelines.why: The count is the quickest way to see where work is piling up.

guidelines.do: Keep to three to five stages.
guidelines.dont: Create a column for every status in the system.
guidelines.why: Too many columns are hard to scan and scroll.

guidelines.do: Put the move action on each card.
guidelines.dont: Require drag and drop as the only way to move a card.
guidelines.why: A menu works with the keyboard and on touch screens.

accessibility.role: region named by label; each column is a section with a heading.

keyboard.action: Moves through the cards’ actions in reading order.

aria.when: Each column is named by its title.

accessibility.focus: Card actions show their own focus rings.

wcag.how: Columns are sections with headings; cards are headings within them.
Every card action is reachable with the keyboard.

notes: Each column reads as a heading followed by its cards, so the stages are easy to navigate.

examples.title: Three stages
examples.description: To do, in progress and done.

examples.title: With a move menu
examples.description: A menu on each card to move it to another stage.
examples.code:
import { KanbanBoard } from '@ds/react';

<KanbanBoard label="Tasks" columns={columns} renderActions={(item, column) => <MoveMenu item={item} from={column.id} />} />

components.name: KanbanBoard
components.description:
Work grouped into columns by stage: each column has a title and count, and each task is a card
with its detail and metadata. Use it to see and move work across stages.

compact.description: Tighter cards and gaps, to fit more tasks on screen.

renderActions.description: Controls at the end of each card, e.g. a menu to move it to another column.

--kanban-board-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--kanban-board-column-gap.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--kanban-board-column-padding.description: Gap between related items in a group.

--kanban-board-column-border-radius.description: Controls and small surfaces: inputs, buttons, menu items.

--kanban-board-column-bg-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--kanban-board-card-meta-color.description: Supporting text on surfaces: descriptions, metadata, placeholders.

--kanban-board-compact-card-gap.description: Hairline gap (2px), e.g. between rating stars.
